message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r7d (Codex r8 conditions) -- the tap only in the same viewer and connection as the pick; a 4 FAIL ends the arm

Codex codex_old_apk_lane_ime_status_r8.md, on c468c27:
- same_viewer(): since the last successful pick (PICK_MARK: the app log cursor and the host log length) the app
  logged no scene but VIEWER, no [status] that is not connected, no new select_request, and the host no
  `udp control session ended` / new `client connected`. viewer_tap_point() asks it first: not the same -> no tap.
  (The tap itself: the video view's centre from the UI dump, the keyboard hidden -- c468c27.)
- a 4 FAIL returns at once: no menu wake tap, no 5 / 6 / P-5d (NOT RUN) -- the r7c run went on into three menu
  attempts on a viewer that had already gone.
- not done, by the conditions: no BACK without the keyboard shown (and only on the PC list, judged after), no Enter,
  the keyboard service untouched. No secret text is logged (the password field's step names the field only).

oa_pick_test.py 31/31: + 4 after the app left the viewer (HOSTS / status error) -> FAIL, no tap; + 4 after the host
ended the session -> FAIL, no tap; + the 4-FAIL-ends-the-arm path present in the source (a source check: the full
S flow is not driven by the stub). Regressions: oa_pmclear_test 12/12, oa_adb_redact_test 7/7,
oa_orchestration_test 22/22. No device run.
